entity.name: Hub Stacey's at The Point
entity.editorial_summary: Unpretentious hangout with burgers, sandwiches & bar bites, plus live music & outdoor seating.
entity.description: Serving both the Pensacola and Perdido Key Florida areas. Hub Stacey's offers the best sandwiches in the area. Dine in or take-out, you won't be disappointed with the large portions and fantastic sandwiches. Hub's is the home of the best food, spirits, and music. Our music lineup consists of country, rock, blues, funk, and all the good ballads! Hundreds of musicians perform at both of our locations year round.
